verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for Elasticsearch's REST API. The probe found no spec at any common candidate path (/openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json all returned 404). The client libraries and the MCP server mentioned in the docs are not machine-readable API specs, so the story is unevidenced.
